brief: One drawer and one spike, both at the very same corner of the same cell, touching.

requirements.requirement: One drawer and one spike at the very same corner of the same cell, touching
requirements.evidence: Build has spike:0#0,1|1,0|1,1 at junction 0,1|1,0|1,1. No drawer placed. Configurator enforces SPIKE_CLASH / socket validity: spikes live where three cells meet, notch/drawers occupy empty notch cells beside two bases. No socket offered a drawer at same junction as the spike; placing both at identical corner is refused by placement rules. Current meshClash=clear but requirement not satisfied.

finish.summary: Could not co-locate drawer and spike at same corner - configurator provides no drawer socket at the spike junction. Built triangular 3-cell base with spike at 0,1|1,0|1,1 as closest achievable; drawer remains unplaced due to SPIKE_CLASH / placement rule.
